audit_title: FinGuard Phase 3B - Behavioural Model Prediction Parity Audit Report

root_cause_analysis.primary_cause: Pandas 3.0 String Dtype Missing Value Propagation vs Pandas 1.x String Literal Conversion
root_cause_analysis.mechanism: In pandas 1.x (the original Kaggle runtime), calling .astype(str) on columns containing missing float/object values converts NaN to the literal string 'nan'. In pandas 3.0+ (the local virtual environment), .astype(str) preserves nullable NA. When card columns (card1-card6) were concatenated with '_' to construct the card key, any row with a missing card attribute resulted in NA. Pandas groupby() drops NA groups by default (dropna=True), leaving prior_card_count, prior_amount_mean, and amount_deviation as NaN. In the validation set, exactly 2,182 records had missing card details, resulting in 2,181 prediction discrepancies up to 0.3425. Explicitly applying .fillna('nan').astype(str) restores exact Kaggle card key behavior.

verified_feature_specifications.prior_card_count: df.groupby('card_key').cumcount() - Strictly causal 0-indexed prior transaction velocity
verified_feature_specifications.prior_amount_mean: (cumsum - amt) / cumcount.replace(0, np.nan) - Strictly causal prior cumulative mean volume
verified_feature_specifications.amount_deviation: (TransactionAmt - prior_amount_mean) / np.abs(prior_amount_mean) - Relative signed deviation from prior mean
verified_feature_specifications.card_key: card1_card2_card3_card4_card5_card6 with NaNs preserved as 'nan' strings
verified_feature_specifications.categorical_encoding: 14 categorical columns (ProductCD, card4, card6, P_emaildomain, R_emaildomain, M1-M9) encoded using deterministic .astype('category').cat.codes

corrections_made.modification: Applied .fillna('nan').astype(str) on card1 through card6 to prevent nullable NA propagation under pandas 3.0+ and restore exact pandas 1.x Kaggle string composite key semantics.
Standardized amount_deviation formula to explicitly divide by np.abs(df['prior_amount_mean']).
